issue: Every chat turn takes seconds with nothing on screen saying why

issue: The report takes tens of seconds after the last person finishes, unannounced
evidence: FIXED: the page polls while the server says the report is being written, and says it is checking.

issue: A participant sees a report with nothing in it and a button to reveal it, with no explanation of the button
evidence: FIXED: there was no button — `reportsApi.activate` had no caller anywhere. There is now a screen explaining the exchange and a control that performs it.

issue: Something the organiser expected to do was refused

issue: Finishing too early shows a refusal before the composer re-opens

issue: The report-ready email never says what Groundwork is

issue: Only 7 distinct email shapes were sent across 910 emails

issue: 224 of 237 check-ins never say who will read what somebody writes
evidence: CORRECTED then FIXED: measured from the transcripts, but the SCREEN does say it — a first-session explainer plus a header line. The real defect underneath: the explainer was gated on sessionNumber === 1, so anybody added halfway through was never shown it. That gate is fixed.

issue: 27 of 145 reports were written and never released, so they were shown to nobody
evidence: CORRECTED: not a defect. Release is a deliberate admin press ("report ready — you release it"), and the audit runner never pressed it. Worth noting that the shared report is readable before release, so what release means is unclear to both sides.

issue: 16 documents were attached and 1 report of 145 mentions one
evidence: FIXED twice over: the report carries a computed "what this record rests on" per reader, and documents everybody can see are NAMED in the synthesis corpus with what was read from them. Driven: the report says "the offer letter, which they state was signed by both, gives sign-off authority to the head of delivery".

issue: The uploader is handed back id, name, mimeType, uploadedAt and an assessment — and no visibility, so nobody can tell who will see the file they just attached
evidence: FIXED: both upload paths now select the column, and the answer is a sentence rather than the enum — honouring the CONTEXT_ENABLED flag so it cannot contradict the read path.

issue: A finished check-in has no summary of its own: somebody who answered for ten minutes is handed nothing until everybody else has answered too
evidence: CORRECTED then FIXED: not missing — it arrives about 22 seconds after finishing, because it is built fire-and-forget so a model failure cannot block completion. Driven and timed. The endpoint now says which of the three states it is in rather than returning a bare null.
